summary.title: 📌 Central log server
summary.description:
This server receives **a copy of every log** from the servers below (one channel per log type) and the **in-game logs** of the FiveM servers.
• **🌐 GENERAL**: what matters across all servers (sanctions, security, bot).
• **One section per Discord server**: MODERATION · MESSAGES & MEMBERS · SERVER & ACTIVITY.
• **🎮 GAME**: connections, accounts, kills, matches, sanctions, admin actions, anticheat, server.
Each log header shows its source server. `/template logs`: add a server, repair a deleted channel, remove a source.

template.title: 🗂️ Central log server
template.hint:
This server will become **the log server** of your servers: every linked server gets its own categories (moderation · messages & members · server & activity), every game server gets its **GAME** category, and **GENERAL** gathers the sanctions and alerts of every server.
1️⃣ Pick the Discord servers in the menu.
2️⃣ Enable in-game logs for the FiveM servers (🎮 yes · 💬 yes + chat).
3️⃣ Click **Create the structure**.
template.hint_existing: This server is the **central log server**. Add a server in the menu then **Repair / complete**: missing channels are recreated, nothing is duplicated. Removing it from the menu does not unlink it: use **Remove a source**.
template.security: 🔒 Only servers where you are **administrator** or **owner** can be linked (checked on each server). A server can be linked to one log server only.

template.games_hint: Click a game server: ⬜ no → 🎮 yes → 💬 yes + in-game chat.
